description.value: Columbia Street Sandwich Company is a woman-owned cafe on New Westminster's main downtown street, turning out homemade soups, fresh-baked goods, and a wide range of sandwiches from a counter-service setup with outdoor seating. The shop has more than 15 years of cafe and catering experience and serves vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly options alongside its classic lineup. Their Lunch Bag catering service makes it a practical resupply point for supported cycling tours passing through the Lower Mainland.
